source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 17: the battle on the shore of the salt sea; the asuras hurl mountain peaks; Narayana calls to mind the discus Sudarshana, which comes blazing like fire; Nara with his divine bow shatters the peaks with gold-tipped arrows; the asuras enter the earth and the salt sea; the gods set Mandara back in its place and keep the amrita safe. Sauti closes the embedded tale (the horse's origin) and returns to Kadru and Vinata (1.18).
structure: From episode 11: COLD OPEN (the hook over the episode's strongest image, big on-screen text from frame 1; KIT.series.hookCard) → title (the hook's post) → RECAP (≈2.5 s) → STORY (with a brief cut to Sauti at the Naimisha fire) → the cliffhanger image + line → a silent ≈1.5 s Next card that dissolves back into the first frame (KIT.series.loopNextScene).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Gods against asuras: who would keep the drink that ends death?
lines.say: Gods against asuras: [p:100] who would keep the drink that ends death?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (moving from frame 1): the battle on the shore at night, fire in the sky; a deva and an asura LARGE in the foreground clash, weapons crossing; a blazing discus streaks overhead. The question in big text from frame 1.

lines.text: The asuras saw they had been tricked.
lines.say: The asuras saw they had been tricked.
lines.note: RECAP: episode 15's last image as a memory: the enchantress turning gold, the asuras raising their weapons.

lines.text: On the shore of the salt sea, gods and asuras clashed, and the sky filled with weapons.
lines.say: On the shore of the salt sea, [p:80] gods and asuras clashed, [p:80] and the sky filled with weapons.
lines.note: STORY 1. NEW PLACE AND LIGHT: the shore in battle at night: a sky lit red from below by fires, smoke, streaks of weapons crossing it. A wide frieze of the two hosts meeting (beats[1] 'clashed', a drum); the sky fills (beats[3]).

lines.text: The asuras tore up mountain peaks and hurled them.
lines.say: The asuras tore up mountain peaks [p:80] and hurled them.
lines.note: STORY 2. Close: an asura, LARGE, heaves a mountain peak overhead (beats[1]) and throws it (beats[2]); peaks fly across the red sky.

lines.text: Then Narayana called his discus, Sudarshana, blazing like fire.
lines.say: Then Narayana called his discus, [p:120] Sudarshana, [p:80] blazing like fire.
lines.note: STORY 3 · THE TURN (≈ 45 %): after a 350 ms rest, Narayana frontal and LARGE raises his hand; the discus comes down out of the sky, blazing (beats[2] its name card, a bell); it spins, flaring (beats[3]).

lines.text: Beside him, Nara drew his great bow, and his arrows split the falling peaks.
lines.say: Beside him, [p:80] Nara drew his great bow, [p:100] and his arrows split the falling peaks.
lines.note: STORY 4: Nara in profile, LARGE, draws his bow (beats[1] name card, beats[2] draw); a streak of white-gold light (loose) and on 'split' (beats[3]) a falling peak bursts into fragments of light.

lines.text: The asuras fled, into the earth and into the sea.
lines.say: The asuras fled, [p:100] into the earth [p:80] and into the sea.
lines.note: STORY 5: the discus sweeps the shore; the asuras sink away into cracks of the earth (beats[1]) and dive under the waves (beats[2]): stylised, no blood: they vanish as shadows into earth and water.

lines.text: Mandara was set back in its place, and the gods kept the amrita safe.
lines.say: Mandara was set back in its place, [p:150] and the gods kept the amrita safe.
lines.note: STORY 6: dawn after the battle: the mountain floats back down to its plain in clear morning light (beats[0]); the gods stand round the white pot, its light calm (beats[2]).

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: And that is how the white horse rose from the ocean.
lines.say: And that is how the white horse rose from the ocean.
lines.note: FRAME, closing the tale within the tale: Sauti at the Naimisha fire, the sages nodding; above the fire a gold-ringed medallion shows the white horse once more (beats[0]).

lines.text: Back on the shore, Kadru and Vinata looked at the white horse.
lines.say: Back on the shore, [p:100] Kadru and Vinata looked at the white horse.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger image): the shore at sunrise again (episode 11's place): the two sisters LARGE, the horse far out on the water.

lines.speaker: kadru
lines.note: NEXT 2 (Kadru speaks): close on Kadru, the green glint in her eye; she points at the horse's tail. beats = 'colour', 'tail'. (The text is exactly the catalog cliffhanger: the narrator line and Kadru's question.)
The short, silent Next card: a glimpse of episode 17 (a new arc, Garuda): the sisters face to face, the horse between them; then the loop back to frame 1.
